column1: # One row per image: name  repository  tag  index_digest  amd64_digest  signature
# index_digest  = digest of the multi-arch manifest index (what cosign signs for LiteLLM)
# amd64_digest  = digest of the linux/amd64 manifest listed by that index; this is what the
#                 units pin (Image=repo:tag@amd64_digest) and what lands on the server.
# Read from the registries' manifest APIs on 2026-09-14 (openwebui: 2026-09-17).
